message.content: This editorial illustration for Tempo magazine features a composite of several men in athletic jerseys against the backdrop of a stadium. The central figure is a man with dark curly hair and a beard, wearing a red jersey with black and white trim. He has his head tilted back and mouth open in a shout, with his right fist clenched in front of his chest. Below him, two more men are prominently displayed. On the left, a man in a red jersey with green stripes looks forward with an open mouth. On the right, a man in a green jersey with white trim is depicted in a dynamic pose, reaching out with one arm and shouting. In the background, smaller figures of men in various jerseys also appear to be shouting. The background shows the tiers of a stadium under a warm light. Large white text "SALAH SALEH SEPAK BOLA" is centered over the middle of the illustration. Additional text includes "TEMPO" at the top, "MIMPI BURUK PENGIKUT AHMADIYAH," "BANK WAKAF PENANGKAL RENTENIR," and detailed publication information with a barcode at the bottom right.
